title: HttpOnly Cookie Authentication
outcome: Use HttpOnly cookies for Seneca backend session tokens. Dual-token system: Kinde JWT (memory) + Seneca session (HttpOnly). Never localStorage for sensitive tokens.
rationale: XSS protection (HttpOnly), CSRF protection (SameSite), secure transmission (HTTPS), automatic inclusion in requests.
security_benefits: XSS Prevention: HttpOnly prevents document.cookie access
CSRF Prevention: SameSite=Strict prevents cross-site requests
Secure Transmission: Secure flag requires HTTPS
Token Theft: Cannot steal HttpOnly cookies even with XSS
